heading: Secretary to the Appeal Tribunal
content:
46.
Secretary to the Appeal Tribunal
(1)
There shall be a Secretary to the Appeal Tribunal for the purpose of providing administrative services to an Appeal Tribunal.
(2)
The Secretary to the Appeal Tribunal shall be—
(a)
appointed by the Secretary;
(Amended L.N. 330 of 1999; L.N. 106 of 2002; L.N. 130 of 2007; 16 of 2011 s. 29)
(b)
a public officer; and
(c)
a person other than a member of the Appeal Tribunal Panel.
